note: Family-run campground in the town of Medora, the gateway to the Theodore Roosevelt National Park South Unit, laid out in sections by hookup type. Wood fires are banned by city ordinance (propane or charcoal grills only). --Claude
summary: Operator site: 2026 rates $49 dry / $51 E / $53 E+W / $55 FHU, pull-through $69, Good Sam 10% (FHU $49.50); 100 sites 30/50 amp; showers, laundry, store, wifi, dump; phone-only reservations; season May 15-Sep 30 (off-season self-contained sites). Transient tourist park, no long-stay offer. DROP CANDIDATE on reviews: Google 3.7 from 481. Pin ok.
